title: Classify and improve remaining castle interior warnings without weakening QA
description:
EVIDENCE
The settled INT-007 run artifacts/castle_voxel_final.log passes 84 canonical CastleQA fixtures with 0 failures and 204 warnings: seating 158, nav 12, focus 10, shelf_over 10, against 8, shape 4, sconce_pair 2. Read docs/CASTLE_INTERIOR_WARNINGS.md for every category, exact message, source branch and fixture inventory. This is a triage/improvement task, not a requirement to reach zero warnings.

EXISTING OWNERSHIP / DO NOT DUPLICATE
INT-005 (9b822ee0-3f71-40ad-b169-952dd56de7df, executing at audit) owns chapel axis/sightline work; attach the chapel findings there when appropriate. HOUSE-POLYGON-AFFINITY (c658d3e0-66b8-45f1-846d-b4102caf02d8, pending) owns the confirmed four-AABB-wall assumptions in secondary affinity/checker helpers. The pending alchemist shelf failure (20ad71a4-5c54-4805-9fc2-9877aafb24f4) is longhall/alchemist 12x16 m, one storey, seed 60068, 0% shelf cover at 2.43 m; it is a distinct failure. Existing row, focus and affinity mechanics INT-001/INT-002/LAY-003 are complete. Re-check live task state before implementation.

EXACT STARTING FIXTURES AND BRANCHES
- seating 158: all chapel nave benches across 24 fixtures. Start norman/castle/0 seed 9249 (40x55x14 m), chapel room0: 'Bench ... is not at any table'. HouseFurnisher's nave recipe intentionally emits pew rows and a distant altar. HouseFurnishCheck._check_seating/_nearest_table use the generic 1.6 m table-centre association and do not account for that role.
- focus 10: all chapel CandleStick_Stand sightline warnings. Start norman/castle/0 seed9249 chapel room0; also edwardian/castle/1 seed9250 (60x90x18 m). HouseFurnishCheck._check_focus tests a 1.6m-high eye 0.5m inside the door against full placement AABBs toward 90% of altar height. Inspect actual stand silhouette/pose before deciding whether placement or the visibility approximation needs work.
- nav 12: yard_stable, castle/1 seed9250 (60x90x18 m) reports 1.1m2; fortress/1 seed9118 (140x200x24 m) reports 0.9m2, in Norman/Edwardian/Crusader/Bavarian/Japanese/Moorish. HouseNavCheck._check_islands warns above 0.6m2 of standable but unreached floor. Required rooms/doors/use zones pass. Inspect ascii_map(0), measured stall footprint and real pocket; do not substitute a room-access failure claim.
- shelf_over 10: norman/fortress/0 seed9117 (90x140x20 m), yard_blacksmith room0: 0% cover, 2.00m; norman/fortress/1 seed9118, yard_general_store room1: 0% cover, 2.17m. _check_shelf_over warns only when _fs_could_hang_over finds no station. _fs_back_wall is AABB-based and feeds actual room_walls; producer _back_wall_index/_window_crowding/_over_bonus retain related assumptions. The helper mismatch is confirmed, but these shop warnings are not proven polygon errors. Check openings, mounted objects, widths and actual wall identity. Preserve the blacksmith workbench daylight fix.
- against 8: keep Cabinets carry an explicit free_standing flag. Start edwardian/castle/0 seed9249 rooms1 and3. HouseFurnisher._place_one records the fallback after wall placement fails; _check_against_wall recognizes it. Investigate a better feasible layout without treating a documented fallback as an unreported hard defect.
- shape 4: hall room0. Edwardian castle/2 seed9251 (80x145x22 m): 6.3x44.3m; Edwardian fortress/0 seed9117: 3.5x28.2m; French_chateau castle/1 seed9250: 4.8x29.9m; French_chateau fortress/1 seed9118: 10.0x60.3m. HousePlanCheck._check_shapes compares HouseGeometry.room_aspect with aspect_max; minimum-size checks pass. Investigate hall-plan/host-range proportions, not roof-hole assumptions.
- sconce_pair 2: edwardian/castle/0 seed9249 and castle/1 seed9250, keep lords_chamber room3, lopsided on wall10. _check_sconce_pair already uses actual polygon facets. Same wall without symmetry is a warning directly and does not prove no symmetric arrangement fits. Preserve completed polygon pair identification/placement regressions.

REPRODUCE
Use CastleSweep.spec_at(style,tier,index), CastleBuilder.build, CastleQA.check; select builder.interiors by stable id and inspect report.buildings[id]. For nav run HouseNavCheck.check on that local plan and print ascii_map(0) from the same checker. Full reproduction: Godot --headless --path . --script res://tests/run_all.gd -- cvoxelqa, using the executable from AGENTS.md. The recorded 1949.20s sweep ran concurrently with other suites and is not an isolated benchmark.

IMPLEMENTATION SCOPE
Record evidence and disposition for each category before changing code. Fix demonstrated placement/programme problems or improve a checker only with an independent physical/semantic basis. Preserve legitimate recorded compromises and honest grid pockets in the report until a feasible improvement is proven. Do not disable rules, turn confirmed failures into warnings, shrink measured furniture/body bounds, raise navigation thresholds, or classify all warnings as defects/waived. Coordinate overlapping implementation with the existing tasks above.
aiNotes: Registered after root review on 2026-09-13. Seven warning categories and exact fixtures are documented in docs/CASTLE_INTERIOR_WARNINGS.md. Coordinate overlapping chapel and polygon-affinity tasks; remaining warnings are not all proven defects or recorded compromises.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Each of the seven warning categories has a recorded fixture-level disposition supported by plan fields, measured geometry, the relevant rule branch, or a room render. Counts and remaining warnings are documented honestly; zero warnings is not required.
- Coordinate chapel axis/sightline work with INT-005 and secondary wall geometry with HOUSE-POLYGON-AFFINITY. Preserve or resolve the distinct seed60068 alchemist shelf failure if shared helpers change.
- Any role-aware pew check still detects a reversed/misaligned row or blocked aisle and retains strict dining-seat checks. Any sightline refinement still detects an actual opaque blocker.
- Any stable improvement preserves measured body/prop bounds, door/stall orientation and all required use zones; retain before/after WalkGrid maps and stranded area.
- Any shelf/wall/sconce change is verified against actual room edges and available intervals; preserve negative controls for a shelf ignoring valid space, invalid lamp pairs, bad polygon bounds and blocked paths.
- Any hall proportion change preserves courtyard voids, plan-to-shell opening/floor alignment, roof joins and required programme.
- Run relevant focused existing suites after implementation and the full 84-case cvoxelqa sweep; it must retain zero failures, with remaining warnings and any new regressions explicitly reported.
